title: What I Couldn't Give
description: Electric Dreams Musical - Technology & Desire | Setting: Marcus Sterling's apartment - Cambridge, expensive but empty at 11:30 PM, September 17th - after the committee meeting | Characters: Dr. Marcus Sterling (alone with his regrets)
stage_directions: He takes another drink.. He swipes through the footage - Evelyn, brilliant and driven and completely unreachable.
character_notes: He doesn't answer. He can't explain to his mother that he's trying to save the woman he loves from herself, and failing.
